label_author: Codex AI-authored before provider evaluation; inspectable diagnostic labels, not human truth
intended_use: Counterfactual diagnostic and regression; no estimate of population accuracy or investment returns.

protocol.provider_input: question and only cutoff-eligible original sources; reference labels and obligations excluded
protocol.comparison: Same question, eligible original bytes, support criteria, context budget, one first attempt and configured confidence thresholds; confidence thresholds must be reported separately.
protocol.cost_rule: Report provider denominators, actual usage and saved price assumptions; missing cost remains null.
limitations: Synthetic paired variations are not independent real news examples.
Exact quotations and required condition coverage verify transport, not semantic correctness.
AI-authored reference labels may be ambiguous; preserve disagreements for independent review.
No profit, causal market explanation, or deployment superiority is measured.
protocol.observation_clock_rule: When source observed_at or period_end is supplied, it must be timezone-aware and no later than source publication and acquisition. Future planned event_at is not treated as an observed outcome.
